messages:
nik_marketing: Quick sync — webinar tomorrow 11am PT. Need final speaker transitions, audience routing plan, and demo fallback trigger. Keep replies short.
aya_prod: I'm good. Bench bullets to call out on slide: median latency ~75ms, ~2x cost drop with caching+quant, Dedicated for tail SLOs. One line each.
colin_demo: Demo lead here. Live plan: private-stage primary, auto-fail to private-backup at latency>450ms or errors>2% for 30s, then hosted-readonly as last resort. Pre-recorded clip queued at T+6 for immediate swap.
ruth_ops: Recording starts 10:40. Speakers join 10:20 for mic checks. I'll post status flags in the channel. On failover I'll post "OP: failover -> hosted-readonly" so producer can cue clip.
sam_growth: Polls: minute 4 "Primary infra pain?" (latency/cost/scaling/observability). Minute 23 "Want a sandbox?" yes/no. We'll tag leads by poll + Q&A interest for nurture.
ops-bot: reminder: rehearsal room booked zoom.redwood.com/room-7. Resource check: private-stage pool 3/6 GPUs free.
nik_marketing: Run-of-show (tight):
1) 10:40 - recorder on, mic checks
2) 11:00 - Intro (nik) - 3m
3) 11:03 - Bench narrative (aya) - 7m
4) 11:10 - Live demo (colin) - 9m
5) 11:19 - Deep dive routing/cost (aya) - 6m
6) 11:25 - Q&A + poll review - 12m
7) 11:37 - CTA & wrap (nik) - 3m

aya_prod: Speaker transition notes: nik to hand off with explicit "demo lead take over" line so ops knows when to mute/unmute. Keep handoffs under 10s.
ruth_ops: Mic plan: speakers in room by 10:20. Quick 20s test each. I'll post :white_check_mark: when good. Producer cues: "3-min warning", "switch to clip", "wrap in 30s".
sam_growth: Post-webinar: email with benchmark PDF + recording, day 2 sandbox invites to poll yes respondents, week 1 personalized outreach for accounts that asked questions.
nik_marketing: Please react with :thumbsup: when ready.
